diagnosis.statement: R44 native normed/inner/star equality declarations and native_witness_shape each print the standard trio; norm_specialization and order_specialization fail at whnf 400000, even without pi, ideal or existential elimination.
The failed specialization is in the concrete Hilbert/dictionary conversion path, not dependent ideal witness elimination. R44 does not yet identify a unique expensive dictionary projection.

Cache the existing native NormedAddCommGroup, InnerProductSpace, NormedSpace, Module, topology, uniformity, completeness, operator star/order while transparent. Mark only GNSHilbert locally irreducible, then pass principal Hilbert dictionaries explicitly in generic applications. This targets eager unfolding of the nested concrete orbit-closure subtype; it is not a new Hilbert model.

structural_changes: Native dictionaries are reducible aliases, not newly assembled records or transported norms.
Only local elaborator reducibility changes. The actual GNSHilbert definition, pi and lambda remain original; imported production sources are untouched.
Two bounded Hilbert-only specialization declarations precede the same three concrete consumer targets.
Order consumer calls the specialized order theorem and transports map_star equalities through a typed norm function, preserving bb* orientation.
Generic existential elimination remains abstract; no repeat of concrete obtain/cases bottleneck.
